purpose: legislators:PK:Punjab:seats reserved for women, for minorities/non-Muslims and any other reserved category
query: List the CURRENT members of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab (Punjab, Pakistan) holding the seats reserved for women, for minorities/non-Muslims and any other reserved category, as of 2026-11-15. For each member give full name, constituency code and name (for constituency seats), seat type (general, women_reserved, minority_reserved, other_reserved), party name and acronym, term start, whether the seat was won in a by-election, and source URLs that list this person as a member for this seat. Account for by-elections, deaths, resignations and disqualifications since the general election; omit vacant seats.
text: As of 2026-11-15, the list includes 66 women’s and 8 non-Muslim reserved-seat members. The July 2025 reinstatement of 27 previously suspended seats is reflected in the assembly’s full member directory and the election notification reporting. Reserved seats have no geographic constituency, so constituency fields are null; no other reserved category is identified. Term starts are given as 2024, the assembly term, rather than an unsupported individual oath date.
